scope.zh: 修复初始化期间提前缓存的旧文档覆盖与后续编辑事件漏发窗口；在读操作内原子取得当前文档快照、安装监听器并创建首次didOpen future；didOpen与didChange共用既有FIFO dispatcher，移除500ms经验性等待。；拒绝已删除或项目已关闭的延迟连接，并在真实VFS删除前取消被删除缓存PSI的原生特性请求。；Find Usages的新鲜及缓存查询共同遵守Global/Local搜索范围，严格包含去重仅比较相同VirtualFile的结果，保留部分重叠与相同ranges。；增加Find Usages专用可覆盖查询策略，Go仅聚合声明/定义/引用，不自动查询类型定义/实现；独立导航能力与真实引用错误通知不变。；四类位置导航缓存使用文档/PSI及已匹配watcher/服务器配置生命周期依赖epoch；稳定依赖保留缓存，跨文件或语义依赖变更重新查询；初始化后实际RPC之前建立server基线，拒绝过期inflight结果。；四类导航入口将previousOffset检查、旧代取消、参数更新及future访问置于同一实例monitor，防止同文件不同offset并发复用对方future。；高亮请求等待已打开文档的didOpen/didChange，通过同一FIFO发送，并以原生文档序列及已连接服务器/文档身份保护排队、交付与缓存；取消只影响请求自己的future。；标准Pause使用真实线程ID异步请求，并等待ACK与真实暂停事件共同完成；支持allThreadsStopped但无threadId的暂停事件。标准Step/Continue绑定原生选中栈、当前暂停context与CAS认领的代次；冷/热栈加载不改变选择，过期回包不发布。；延迟本地调试源码的导航对象在父描述符中保留真实行号，使原生编辑器首次冷打开通过canNavigateTo并定位到执行行。；补全请求在捕获的原生文档代次上等待didOpen/didChange，并通过同一FIFO发送；单请求取消不传播到共享文档通知。

dapSessionControlsRevision.status: Seventeen-source public build integration. Official compiler/SDK evidence is recorded separately from standalone desktop delivery; native Pause/cold-goroutine verification remains required.
scope: Standard startPausing sends a bounded worker-thread DAP request using a server-returned running thread ID

Only actual stopped events publish a paused context; allThreadsStopped permits no threadId; a Pause operation requires both its ACK and actual sessionPaused before releasing its duplicate gate, under the same 5-second deadline
Real selected stack is captured with exact context identity and a CAS-claimed generation before resume, revalidated at consumption, and used once by standard Step/Continue
Cold and warm stack loading never selects a goroutine; obsolete/resumed/replaced/disposed contexts reject late data
Stop and session lifecycle invalidate pending Pause lookup without an EDT wait

Pause state/completion invalidation remains immediate; protocol cancellation from direct cancel and completion failure is deduplicated and dispatched on a worker because root LSP4J cancel emits transport bytes synchronously.
A five-second missing ACK/paused-state deadline reports an explicit bounded failure instead of a null message; it never fabricates a suspended session.
boundaries: Controlled real SDK peer proof is not native CUA or a real-Delve cold-goroutine selection proof
Raw Delve1.27.2 Pause/heartbeat control separately proves server protocol shape; no thread ID is invented
The global native Pause Program entry was observed failing only in the old unchanged cohort; candidate native action remains pending
